name: Please Be Quiet Johor 2025

venue.name: University of Southampton Malaysia
venue.address: 3, Eko Galleria, C0301, C0302, C0401, Blok C, Taman, Persiaran Eko Botani, 79100 Iskandar Puteri, Johor Darul Ta'zim

information:
### **Note: This competition does not feature the 3x3x3 Cube event.**

Welcome to Please Be Quiet Johor 2025! This will be a small competition featuring only blindfolded events. For those who are interested in joining **Malaysia FMC Championship 2025** can register through [here](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/Competition/Info/MalaysiaFMCChampionship2025). The event will take place at the same venue immediately after the end of this competition.
​
